title: Bias-Free FedGAN: A Federated Approach to Generate Bias-Free Datasets
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on demonstrating and mitigating class-based bias in federated generative adversarial networks (FedGAN) on image datasets (MNIST, FashionMNIST).
references: 2018 reform of eu data protection rules.
